mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, provider_key, display_name, issuer_uri, client_id, client_secret, scopes, enabled, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM tenant_oidc_provider WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY provider_key ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, provider_key, display_name, issuer_uri, client_id, client_secret, scopes, enabled, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM tenant_oidc_provider WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND provider_key=#{providerKey}

SELECT id, tenant_id, provider_key, display_name, issuer_uri, client_id, client_secret, scopes, enabled, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM tenant_oidc_provider WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_oidc_provider (id, tenant_id, provider_key, display_name, issuer_uri, client_id, client_secret, scopes, enabled, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{providerKey}, #{displayName}, #{issuerUri}, #{clientId}, #{clientSecret}, #{scopes}, #{enabled}, 1, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_oidc_provider WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
